raidSayLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Alma Sanders. Social worker. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Mother's Ring, Coat button, Dispatcher's headset, Photo album, Trail compass. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night,
A man, maybe 60s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
The humming in the grass stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, something heavy rooting in the grass, dust rising for no reason, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, something heavy rooting in the grass, dust rising for no reason, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY

📓 Journal: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, something heavy rooting in the grass, dust rising for no reason, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline at the door, day 7.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
⚔️ Aki stood down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and kept walking — 2 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

💬 Maya pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."

📓 Codex: Priya of Ashford raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Priya of Ashford didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
